description: Frontend FX client and conversion helper functions for fetching, converting, and processing foreign exchange rates. It interacts with a backend API to retrieve FX data and provides utility functions to convert currency amounts and series based on rates.

methods.name: fetchLatestFxRates({ base = "USD" } = {})
methods.description: Fetches the latest foreign exchange rates from the backend API, returning an object containing base currency, rates, and timestamp.

methods.name: getFxRate(rates, currency, base)
methods.description: Retrieves the exchange rate for a specific currency from a rates object, considering the base currency.

methods.name: convertAmount(amountUsd, toCurrency, rates, base)
methods.description: Converts a numeric amount from the base currency to the target currency using the provided rates.

methods.name: convertSeries(data, toCurrency, rates, base)
methods.description: Converts an array of labeled data points, adjusting their values according to the FX rates.
